The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Declines committing real secrets and explains Git history cannot be recalled
- Ships .env.example with placeholders, ignores .env, and uses env_file and a required-variable interpolation
- Mentions Compose secrets or _FILE variables as the better option for passwords

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
